verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Jules runs in a virtual machine, where it clones the code, installs dependencies and modifies files (jules-docs-3). A community user independently confirms that it runs in cloud-based VMs rather than on the local machine (jules-comm-1). That covers the core of executing code and installing dependencies in an isolated environment. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the sandbox's isolation and security guarantees (e.g., network restrictions, environment configuration, ephemerality), and hands-on corroboration that code execution and test runs inside the VM work safely.
